contexts.text: There is a chain of subordination... from the Lord...
The metal-caster overlayeth it with gold, and casteth chains of silver () = that by means of reasonings he causes falsities of doctrine to appear true.
To cast chains of silver () = to make them cohere as though they were connected with truths.
Two chains of pure gold () = the coherence with good of the whole Kingdom. Chains = coherence. The reason chains have this signification, is that joinings together are effected by means of them...
That falsities may cohere is signified by he casteth chains of silver.
Thou shalt place the chains of cords upon the sockets () = conjunction with the good from which come truths, and thus the preservation of the Spiritual Kingdom by all work and power.
Thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends () = the conjunction of the whole Heaven in outermost things... Chains = coherence, thus also conjunction.
He casteth chains of silver = by means of coherence.
Like a chain when the hook is removed...
Having a great chain upon his hand () = the endeavour and thence the act of binding and loosing.
In his left hand a chain of pearls.
That falsities may cohere and appear as truths, is signified by he casteth chains of silver.
To be bound with chains () = to be tied up by falsities so that truths cannot come forth.
